intro: Two nineteenth-century ideas meet in one product. Follow the algebra into electron theory, spacetime, graphics and geometric learning. Dates mark selected publications and teaching milestones, not a single uninterrupted invention.
兩條十九世紀的思想在同一個乘積相遇,沿著代數走向電子理論、時空、圖學與幾何學習。

title: I · Build the language
第一部 · 建立語言
subtitle: Rotations, extension and a metric product
旋轉、延伸量與度規乘積

title: II · Meet the physics
第二部 · 走進物理
subtitle: From matrix representations to spacetime algebra
從矩陣表示走向時空代數

title: III · Teach and compute
第三部 · 教學與計算
subtitle: Textbooks, graphics and geometric learning
教材、圖學與幾何學習

title: Hamilton: multiply rotations
哈密頓：讓旋轉可以相乘
paragraphs: Hamilton’s quaternions gave multiplication an order: swapping two factors can change the result. The familiar imaginary number was no longer the only way to extend ordinary numbers.
哈密頓的四元數讓乘法有了順序：交換兩個因子，結果可能改變。熟悉的虛數不再是延伸普通數的唯一方式。
Today we can connect unit quaternions with three-dimensional rotors. That is a useful mathematical bridge, not a claim that the later geometric-algebra notation already existed in 1843.
今天可以把單位四元數連到三維轉子。這是一座好用的數學橋梁，不代表 1843 年就已經有後來整套幾何代數記號。
caption: William Rowan Hamilton, portrait from around 1860.
威廉・羅恩・哈密頓，約 1860 年的肖像。
note: The bridge story comes from Hamilton’s own letters: he recalled the discovery on 16 October 1843 while walking with his wife, and scratching the relation into the bridge stone.
橋上的故事出自哈密頓自己的信：他回憶 1843 年 10 月 16 日與妻子散步時想到關係式，並把它刻在橋石上。

title: Grassmann: let areas be objects
格拉斯曼：把面積當成物件
paragraphs: Grassmann’s Ausdehnungslehre developed a language of extension. Instead of keeping only arrows, it made room for oriented areas and higher-dimensional geometric quantities.
格拉斯曼的《延伸論》發展出描述延伸量的語言。不只記箭頭，也為定向面積與更高維的幾何量留下位置。
The wedge used in this site is modern notation for that line of ideas. Swapping two vectors reverses the oriented area; repeating the same direction makes the area vanish.
本站使用的楔形外積，是這條思想脈絡的現代記號。交換兩個向量會反轉定向面積；重複同一方向則張不出面積。
caption: Hermann Grassmann, portrait made before 1877.
赫爾曼・格拉斯曼，1877 年以前的肖像。

title: Clifford asks whether matter is geometry
克利福德問：物質能否來自幾何？
paragraphs: In an 1870 talk, published in 1876, Clifford proposed that small regions of space could be curved and that changes in curvature might describe the motion of matter.
克利福德在 1870 年的演講、1876 年出版的短文中，提出小區域空間可能彎曲，曲率的變化或許能描述物質的運動。

This is an early geometric proposal about physics. It is not a derivation of Einstein’s field equations or a demonstration of gravitational waves. The distinction lets the original idea remain interesting without rewriting later history.
這是早期以幾何思考物理的提案，並不是愛因斯坦場方程的推導，也不是引力波的證明。分清這點，才能欣賞原本的想法，而不改寫後來的歷史。
caption: William Kingdon Clifford, seated with an open book.
威廉・金頓・克利福德，坐在打開的書本旁。
note: At the end of the short text, Clifford explicitly says his attempted explanation of double refraction had not yet produced decisive results to report.
短文最後，克利福德明確說，他嘗試以此解釋雙折射，但還沒有足夠確定的結果可以發表。

title: A metric product joins the picture
把度規帶進乘法
paragraphs: Clifford’s Applications of Grassmann’s Extensive Algebra connected extensive algebra with metric multiplication. It is a central historical source for what we now call Clifford algebra.
克利福德的〈格拉斯曼延伸代數的應用〉把延伸代數與度規乘法連起來，是今天所稱克利福德代數的重要歷史來源。
In today’s notation, multiplying two vectors keeps both a scalar inner product and a bivector outer product. The scalar records alignment; the bivector records the oriented plane.
用今天的記號來看，兩向量相乘，同時保留純量內積與雙向量外積。前者記平行程度，後者記定向平面。
caption: William Kingdon Clifford, author of the 1878 paper.
威廉・金頓・克利福德，1878 年論文的作者。

sources.label: Original paper · American Journal of Mathematics

title: Dirac: algebra inside the electron equation
狄拉克：電子方程裡的代數
paragraphs: Dirac’s relativistic electron equation uses matrices with anticommutation relations. These are a matrix representation of a Clifford algebra; the electron state is a spinor on which the matrices act.
狄拉克的相對論性電子方程使用滿足反對易關係的矩陣。它們給出克利福德代數的一種矩陣表示；電子狀態則是這些矩陣作用的旋量。

The algebra, its representation and the quantum state have different jobs. Keeping them separate explains the connection without turning a useful mathematical structure into a complete physical theory by itself.
代數、它的表示，以及量子態，各有不同工作。分清三者，既能理解它們的連結，也不會把一種數學結構本身當成完整物理理論。
caption: Paul Dirac in 1933, five years after the electron paper.
1933 年的保羅・狄拉克，距電子方程論文發表五年。

sources.label: David Tong · spinors and the Dirac equation

title: Hestenes builds spacetime algebra
赫斯特尼斯建立時空代數的教學路線
paragraphs: Hestenes’s Space-Time Algebra presents Clifford algebra as a geometric language for spacetime. Its contents connect electrodynamics, Dirac fields, Lorentz transformations and geometric calculus.
赫斯特尼斯的《時空代數》把克利福德代數當成描述時空的幾何語言。書中連起電動力學、狄拉克場、洛侖茲變換與幾何微積分。
For this site, that gives a learning route: understand a plane and a rotor first, then revisit boosts, fields and spinors with a shared set of operations.
對本站而言，這提供一條學習路線：先理解平面與轉子，再用共同的運算工具回頭看雙曲旋轉、場與旋量。
caption: David Hestenes at the ASU SciAPP conference, March 2019.
大衛・赫斯特尼斯，2019 年 3 月於亞利桑那州立大學 SciAPP 會議。

photo.title: David Hestenes ASU March 2019 SciAPP conference.jpg
photo.author: HouseOfChange

title: A textbook connects the physics tools
教材把物理工具連起來
paragraphs: Doran and Lasenby’s Geometric Algebra for Physicists gives a sustained route from the geometric product to rotations, spacetime and physical applications.
多蘭與拉森比的《物理學家的幾何代數》提供一條連貫路線，從幾何積走到旋轉、時空與物理應用。
The role of a textbook is different from a discovery paper: it makes a toolkit learnable. Our foundations and physics pages follow that idea of building one geometric relation at a time.
教材與發現論文的工作不同：它讓一套工具變得可學。本站的基礎與物理頁也沿著這個方向，一次建立一個幾何關係。
caption: Chris Doran (left) / Anthony Lasenby (right).
克里斯・多蘭（左）／安東尼・拉森比（右）。

title: Geometric algebra becomes inspectable code
讓幾何代數成為可檢查的程式
paragraphs: Dorst, Fontijne and Mann’s Geometric Algebra for Computer Science connects geometric objects with algorithms. The authors’ companion site includes interactive figures, exercises and source code.
多斯特、豐泰恩與曼恩的《電腦科學的幾何代數》把幾何物件連到演算法。作者的配套網站提供互動圖、練習與原始碼。
This is the bridge to our programming pages: blade storage, products, transformations and numerical checks must all agree with the picture.
這也是本站程式頁的橋梁：基底儲存、乘積、變換與數值檢查，都必須和圖中的幾何一致。
caption: NVIDIA GeForce 8800 GTX, an example of graphics hardware from that era.
NVIDIA GeForce 8800 GTX，作為當時圖形運算硬體的例子。

title: PGA: one language for rigid geometry
PGA：用共同語言處理剛體幾何
paragraphs: Gunn’s SIGGRAPH 2019 course notes, posted to arXiv in 2020, introduce projective geometric algebra for computer graphics. Points, lines, planes and rigid motions are treated within one model.
岡恩的 SIGGRAPH 2019 課程講義於 2020 年上傳 arXiv，以電腦圖學介紹射影幾何代數，把點、線、面與剛體運動放進同一模型。

The model choice matters: PGA is useful for Euclidean geometry and rigid motion, while other tasks may call for a conformal model or spacetime algebra. This date marks a teaching resource, not the invention of all projective geometry.
模型選擇仍然重要：PGA 適合歐氏幾何與剛體運動，其他任務可能需要共形模型或時空代數。這個日期標記的是教學資源，不是整個射影幾何的發明。
caption: One rigid motion moves points, lines and the shape together.
同一個剛體運動，一致地移動點、線與形狀。

sources.label: Gunn · course notes and publication history

title: Geometry enters neural architectures
把幾何放進神經網路架構
paragraphs: GATr uses projective geometric algebra to represent geometric data inside a transformer. Clifford Group Equivariant Neural Networks studies group actions and constructs equivariant layers using multivectors.
GATr 用射影幾何代數表示 Transformer 裡的幾何資料；克利福德群等變神經網路則研究群作用，並以多重向量建立等變層。

These are concrete architectures and experiments, not proof that every Clifford-based model is faster or more accurate. Compare the symmetry, task, baseline and measured cost before choosing a representation.
這些是具體的架構與實驗，不是所有克利福德模型都更快、更準的證明。選擇表示方式前，仍要比較對稱性、任務、基線與實測成本。
caption: A Tesla P100 GPU, an example of parallel numerical computing hardware.
Tesla P100 GPU，作為平行數值運算硬體的例子。

sources.label: Ruhe et al. · Clifford group networks
